description: Draft a public GitHub issue on aarwitz/tapp about tapp itself — a bug in tapp, an idea, or a question (not a finding about the app under test). Adds the tapp version, platform availability and the latest capture id, and redacts home paths and tokens. Default is a DRAFT with a prefilled github.com URL; pass submit:true only after the user agreed to file a public issue (uses this machine's gh).

body.description: What happened, what you expected, the exact call. No secrets or private source.

submit.description: File the issue now with gh (needs the user's consent). Default false.

name: tapp_feedback
title: Send feedback to the tapp maintainers
